Parts.Description: A wide green meadow with a slate plaza under the Giant Shiba, a ring of bare earth for the stones and a dark patch where the beanstalk will grow.
Parts.Name: Giant's Meadow

Parts.Description: A tall wooden signboard on two posts that warns every traveller about the GIANTS ahead.
Parts.Name: Giant Signpost

Parts.Description: A mossy drystone wall with a gate standing open into the giant's pasture.
Parts.Name: Field Wall

Parts.Description: A tumble of big grey boulders, one wearing a green moss cap.
Parts.Name: Mossy Boulders

Parts.Description: Three daisies as tall as houses, white petals around a golden eye.
Parts.Name: Giant Daisies

Parts.Description: Round and square hay bales piled by the barn with a pitchfork leaning on them.
Parts.Name: Hay Bales

Parts.Description: A sack of magic beans spilled across the grass, one of them already sprouting.
Parts.Name: Magic Beans

Parts.Description: A small cream cottage with a thatched roof, a round window and a smoking chimney.
Parts.Name: Jack's Cottage

Parts.Description: A broad old oak with a thick trunk, wide roots and a crown of layered green leaves.
Parts.Name: Old Oak

Parts.Description: A round stone well with a wooden crank, a bucket on a rope and a little red roof.
Parts.Name: Stone Well

Parts.Description: A fat brown and cream cow chewing grass, the one Jack is supposed to sell.
Parts.Name: Daisy the Cow

Parts.Description: A trail of three enormous muddy footprints, each with five toes, stomping across the meadow.
Parts.Name: Giant Footprints

Parts.Description: Three giant red toadstools with white spots growing in a fairy ring.
Parts.Name: Toadstool Ring

Parts.Description: A blue-shirted scarecrow in a floppy hat with a crow sitting on its arm.
Parts.Name: Scarecrow

Parts.Description: A pair of enormous leather boots the giant kicked off, toes pointing at the Shiba.
Parts.Name: Giant Boots

Parts.Description: A huge iron cauldron of bubbling green soup over a log fire, with a ladle sticking out.
Parts.Name: Giant Cauldron

Parts.Description: The giant's magic golden harp, its strings shining in the sun, on a little stone stand.
Parts.Name: Golden Harp

Parts.Description: A heap of gold coins and jewels around an open treasure chest.
Parts.Name: Gold Hoard

Parts.Description: Three grey stones holding up a giant capstone: an ancient stone doorway grown over with moss.
Parts.Name: Dolmen

Parts.Description: A tall tapering obelisk carved with glowing blue runes and a golden tip.
Parts.Name: Rune Obelisk

Parts.Description: A table big enough for a giant's supper: a plate, a wedge of cheese, a goblet and a fresh loaf.
Parts.Name: Giant Table

Parts.Description: A circle of eight huge grey standing stones, two pairs capped with lintels, around a rune slab.
Parts.Name: Standing Stones

Parts.Description: A three-legged wooden stool with a fat red cushion, tall enough to seat a giant.
Parts.Name: Giant Stool

Parts.Description: A gigantic spiked wooden club stuck in the earth, with iron bands and studs, still cracking the ground around it.
Parts.Name: Giant Club

Parts.Description: A mound of churned earth where the bean has taken hold, with a fat green bulb and six thick roots crawling away.
Parts.Name: Beanstalk Roots

Parts.Description: A little red coop with a straw yard and two ordinary white geese, who have no idea what lives at the top of the stalk.
Parts.Name: Goose Coop

Parts.Description: The beanstalk itself: a thick green stem that twists up 74 studs into the clouds, wrapped in a curling tendril.
Parts.Name: Beanstalk Stem

Parts.Description: Ten huge veined leaves spiralling up the stalk, big enough to walk on, with two fat bean pods hanging between them.
Parts.Name: Beanstalk Leaves

Parts.Description: The giant's castle floating on a cloud high above the meadow: a cream keep, four round towers and blue roofs.
Parts.Name: Cloud Castle

Parts.Description: A great woven nest on top of the beanstalk where the golden goose sits proudly on her golden eggs.
Parts.Name: Golden Goose Nest
